name: Exp_Delta_WPR
summary: This EA trades based on the delta (change) of the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator, entering positions when the momentum shift of WPR exceeds a threshold. It uses fixed lot sizing with stop loss and take profit for trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于威廉百分比指标(WPR)的变化量(Delta)进行交易，当WPR的动量偏移超过阈值时开仓。使用固定手数配合止损和止盈进行仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是利用WPR指标的变化率(Delta)来捕捉市场动量的突变，而非传统地使用WPR的超买超卖区域。入场条件为WPR的Delta值超过预设阈值时，表明动量方向发生了显著偏移，此时顺势开仓做多或做空。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，没有追踪止损或动态退出机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，不根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面较为简单，仅依赖止损来控制单笔风险，缺乏整体账户风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或连亏保护。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is to capture sudden shifts in market momentum by measuring the rate of change (Delta) of the WPR indicator, rather than using traditional overbought/oversold zones. Entry conditions trigger when the WPR Delta exceeds a predefined threshold, signaling a significant momentum shift, at which point the EA opens a position in the direction of the shift. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is relatively simplistic, relying solely on stop loss for per-trade risk control, lacking overall account-level safeguards such as maximum drawdown limits or consecutive loss protection.

parameters.name: Delta_Threshold
parameters.description: WPR变化量阈值，超过此值触发交易
parameters.description_en: WPR change threshold, trade triggered when exceeded

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for distinguishing orders

pros: 利用动量变化率而非静态阈值，能更早捕捉趋势转折点
WPR指标计算简单高效，执行延迟低
固定止损止盈提供了明确的风险收益比控制
pros_en: Using momentum rate of change rather than static thresholds can capture trend turning points earlier
WPR indicator is computationally simple and efficient with low execution latency
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide a clear risk-reward ratio control
cons: 固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，资金管理不够灵活
缺乏追踪止损机制，趋势行情中可能过早平仓错失利润
单一指标策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing does not adapt to account size changes, making money management inflexible
Lack of trailing stop mechanism may cause premature exits and missed profits in trending markets
Single-indicator strategy prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额百分比或ATR调整手数
加入追踪止损功能，在趋势行情中锁定更多利润
增加多时间框架确认或辅助指标过滤，减少震荡市中的假信号
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage or ATR for better capital allocation
Implement trailing stop functionality to lock in more profits during trending moves
Add multi-timeframe confirmation or supplementary indicator filters to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 固定手数在大账户中可能单笔风险过大
缺乏最大持仓限制和连亏保护机制
单一指标在非趋势行情中信号可靠性下降
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size may pose excessive per-trade risk on large accounts
Lack of maximum position limit and consecutive loss protection mechanism
Single indicator reliability diminishes significantly in non-trending market conditions
